note: このJSONの下記『recordedToApprovalTable』のfieldだけが append-only rollout_approval_grants_v2 に記録される。残りは readiness metadata（記録されないが承認判断の根拠）。content_hash は record CLI が grantHash で自動計算する（approvedAt を含むため事前確定不可）。

recordedToApprovalTable.approvalReference: <APPROVER_TO_FILL: e.g. work-order URL / signed doc reference>
recordedToApprovalTable.approvedAt: <APPROVER_TO_FILL: UTC ISO8601, MUST be before the apply run>

policy.validityCondition: valid only while settlementSnapshotIdentity and approvalTargetDigest match; whole-file SHA/size are advisory (change when the grant is recorded); single-use per settlement snapshot
policy.expiry: <APPROVER_TO_FILL: e.g. valid until <UTC>, single-use per snapshot d9b5ddd2…>
policy.rollbackPolicy: resolver-only disable (ignore reparse parse_run) + append-only reversal; original rows preserved; see docs/n2-settlement-reparse-apply-runbook.md
policy.backupRequirement: atomic VACUUM INTO backup + quick_check + integrity_check + FK check before apply
policy.canaryRequirement: fixed deterministic canary cohort + second-run no-op before full apply
policy.postApplyVerificationRequirement: integrity_check ok / FK 0 / orphan 0 / cycle 0 / expected counts match / second-run appended 0 / manifest+digest match

realSidecarApply: NOT_EXECUTED (recording this grant does NOT apply; apply is a separate gated run)
claudeSelfApproval: PROHIBITED — Claude did not and must not create/record this grant
